messages:
Grace: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need a compact governance checklist for rollouts: owners, guardrails, rollback visibility. Drop owner + ETA + one-line blocker.

Omar: I'll own auto-rollback controller and logging. ETA 2026-04-06 for staging PR. Blocker: need consensus on composite metric definition.

Felix: I'll own feature-flag blast-radius enforcement and API validation. ETA 2026-04-02 for proposal doc, 2026-04-09 for schema PR.

Ivy: I'll do canary SLOs and smoke-test pipeline. ETA 2026-03-29 for dashboards and test harness.

safety-bot: Reminder: add `deployment-checklist` and `runbook-update` labels to PRs touching rollout/rollback. Low-traffic window: 2026-04-08 02:00-04:00 UTC.

Grace: Governance checklist (draft): 1) owner + ticket, 2) min_requests + min_windows, 3) composite alert def, 4) rollback audit event, 5) blast_radius cap, 6) manual override with audit, 7) smoke tests.

Omar: Draft composite rule: "rollback if (failure_rate > 1.8% OR p95 > baseline + 50ms) AND sample_size >= 200 for 2 consecutive 5m windows". Will formalize in PR.

Felix: Blast-radius enforcement sketch (yaml): ```yaml
flag: gradual_launch
safety:
  max_blast_radius_pct: 5
  region_scopes: [us-east-1, eu-west-1]
  min_requests: 300
```

Ivy: Smoke test plan: run correctness + latency synthetic load for 3m per stage, verify p95 within threshold and no regression on sample traces. Pipeline job name: canary-smoke-run.

SRE: Ops requirement: rollback audit event must include route, variant_from, variant_to, reason, metric_snapshot, sample_size, trigger_type, and user if manual. 90d retention and index route+variant.

Omar: Will emit `rollback.triggered` with those fields. Also add `rollback.review_required` tag if triggered automatically.

Felix: UI note: add a maintenance-mode toggle to pause auto-rollback for planned windows; must be audit-logged and default to OFF.

Grace: Please add a one-line acceptance criteria to your ticket: e.g., "Auto-rollback: events emitted + canary fails correctly in staging runs".

Ivy: Added dashboards and composite alert card to ticket PGT-9001. Linked an alert playbook.

Omar: Created ticket PGT-9002 and opened draft PR for controller changes. PR will include unit tests and an e2e smoke job entry.

Felix: Created ticket PGT-9003 with proposal doc (WIP). UI mockups attached.

Product: Quick ask 1 1 include a line in each ticket: "who runs the first 3 canaries" and "post-rollback triage owner" so we have clear human escalation.

Grace: Will review tickets mid-week and move items to "in progress" on the postmortem board. If anyone slips, update the ticket and ping me. Closing this thread for tracking only. :white_check_mark:
